digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center harness / provenance test oracle
propositions: The test asserts that remote_key (raw Jira key like RBJNAZV-1) appears in json.dumps(ticket), but the ticket payload uses a lowercased local id (jira-rbjnazv-1) and does not include the raw remote key, making the substring match impossible
The inbound create path records the Jira key only as a title fallback and stores the key-to-id binding separately in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return
The test cannot distinguish between a correctly-created ticket and a non-created ticket, so the test verdict carries no information about whether inbound actually works
The fix requires asserting exact match on ticket id derived via _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally asserting the binding store maps that local id to remote_key
